title: Shemar Stewart doubtful, Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins set to play Week 1

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Shemar Stewart doubtful, Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins set to play Week 1
sources.description: The Bengals are unlikely to have defensive end Shemar Stewart for Sunday's season opener against the Buccaneers, but the rest of their 53-man roster is healthy to play — including receivers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins.
